_readme: One entry per screen shown on the workbench. Raw captures go to assets/screens/raw/<id>.png (and <id>.pt.png when the PT UI differs). The build pipeline in docs/SCREENSHOTS.md turns them into assets/screens/out/<id>[.pt].webp. 'source' tells Claude Code how to obtain each capture; 'manual' entries are provided by Cristiano.

screens.how: Screenshot on the phone of the ESP32 web dashboard (AP BarataEletronics, 192.168.4.1) with a live reading and the calibration chart visible. Prefer a capture from a real measurement session.
DEMO.html of faaast-esp32_v2 running locally (ARRANCAR.ps1), showing live values and the contract agreement.
screens.privacy: Hide any tokens or API keys shown on screen.

screens.how: The 800x480 image Terminus renders for the Open-Meteo plugin (download it from the Terminus preview, or a straight-on photo of the device, cropped).
screens.privacy: Use a city label, not the home address.

screens.how: Screenshot on the Huawei P30 Pro of the light dashboard, landscape.
Android screenshot of the TigTag macro list (kitchen light, bus to work).
screens.privacy: Hide the GitHub token if the settings screen is visible.

screens.how: Export a generated QR with its voxel tree from the Árvore QR page (PNG). If the page has an export button, use it; otherwise screenshot the canvas.
screens.privacy: Encode https://whysoseriusbro.github.io in the QR so a visitor who scans it lands back on the site.

screens.how: Log in as a demo citizen account, open the home map inside a zone with an active questionnaire so the eligibility banner shows.
screens.urlNote: May have moved with the UNINOVA/GRIS handover. Ask Cristiano for the current URL and a demo account; never use a real citizen account.

screens.how: Public Showcase catalogue (no login needed). Capture both the PT and EN versions using the language switcher.
screens.privacy: The Showcase shows institution contacts by design; that is fine. Do not capture any citizen screen.

screens.how: A plan board with several columns and cards.
screens.privacy: Use a demo plan with invented tasks, or blur colleague names and avatars.

screens.how: The agenda list after extraction, with the Generate Word action visible. Also export one page of the generated Word newsletter as PNG for the printed sheet next to the monitor (id gerador-word).
First page of a generated newsletter .docx, exported to PNG.
Run locally (iniciar.bat, localhost:8000), capture the listings table with filters applied.
screens.privacy: Listings are public adverts; hide any Telegram chat ids or personal notes.

screens.how: 3D campus view from the prototype. If no prototype exists yet, keep the illustrated mock from the reference and mark the project 'In planning'.
